reasoning: There are no traditional public polls of the 2026 Wyoming Senate general election in the last 45 days, but multiple reputable forecasting and prediction outlets uniformly rate the race as overwhelmingly Republican, with projected GOP margins of roughly 30–35 points or more.[4][2][11] Wyoming’s very strong underlying Republican lean (R+26 PVI) and these structural forecasts together indicate the current Senate race margin is best characterized as roughly R+30 to R+35, with no credible evidence of a competitive statewide presidential or Senate environment.[4]
